title: Rethinking MDR as Attackers and Defenders Embrace AI
summary: For most of the past decade, managed detection and response was the answer to a real problem. Security teams couldn't staff around the clock, couldn't hire enough analysts, and needed someone else to handle the alert queue. MDR stepped in. It worked well enough. Until now.

title: INTERPOL Operation Takes Down Sniper Dz Phishing Platform, Arrests Administrator

email_summary: An INTERPOL-led operation last month resulted in the disruption of Sniper Dz, a decade-long phishing-as-a-service (PhaaS) platform, Group-IB said Thursday.
